interpretation: Author-derived adapter, not an unmodified upstream test: calls the original HTTPSConnection._connect_tls_proxy using a socketpair TLS peer and trustme CA. A trusted certificate with a mismatching hostname must fail; a matching hostname must succeed. The vendored six importer receives a PEP451 find_spec compatibility method for Python 3.13; TLS methods are unchanged. This distinguishes hostname checking from CA trust failure. No DNS/TCP or full HTTP proxy integration is exercised. Original upstream dummyserver tests remain unrun; the initial import failure is preserved separately.
